hero.title: Committed to quality healthcare and connected patient journeys
hero.subtitle: We bring compassionate care, appointment booking, and medicine ordering into one trusted digital healthcare experience.

story.title: Built to connect hospital care with modern convenience
story.subtitle: Along Hospital started with a simple ambition: make healthcare easier to access, understand, and complete from the first search to the next follow-up.
story.paragraph_1: What began as a hospital-first service experience has grown into a broader platform that helps patients discover care, book appointments with confidence, and continue treatment with less friction.
story.paragraph_2: By connecting medical services, online scheduling, and medicine commerce in one system, we support a calmer journey for patients and a clearer operating flow for healthcare teams.
story.image_alt: Illustration representing Along Hospital growth into connected digital healthcare

principles.title: The principles guiding every patient interaction
principles.subtitle: We design the system around trust, operational clarity, and accessible healthcare experiences.

mission.title: Mission
mission.text: Deliver dependable healthcare journeys that connect in-person treatment, online appointments, and medicine access in one seamless experience.

vision.title: Vision
vision.text: Become the healthcare platform patients rely on for clear decisions, faster access, and a more connected relationship with their hospital.

values.title: Values
values.text: Compassion, transparency, coordination, and continuous improvement shape how we design every public-facing touchpoint.

goals.title: What this platform is designed to solve
goals.subtitle: The public experience supports hospital credibility while making care and commerce easier to complete online.

appointment.title: Appointment booking
appointment.text: Help patients find medical services, choose the right doctor, and schedule visits with less waiting and clearer next steps.

commerce.title: Medicine ecommerce
commerce.text: Extend care beyond the visit through trusted medicine discovery, ordering, and a smoother path to ongoing treatment support.

care.title: Coordinated care experience
care.text: Keep hospital information, consultation access, and digital service touchpoints aligned around one patient journey.
